error.frequencies.imaginary_modes.what: The structure is not a minimum: {count} imaginary frequencies found (lowest {lowest} cm⁻¹).
error.job.checkpoint_invalid.hint: Run the calculation again. A checkpoint is bound to a geometry and basis set and is verified by checksum, so it can neither be moved to another structure nor tampered with.
error.job.checkpoint_invalid.title: Checkpoint is unusable
error.job.checkpoint_invalid.what: The calculation cannot be continued from the saved state: {reason}
error.job.invalid_transition.hint: The job cannot move to this state from its current one. See the allowed transitions in “quantumlab job logs <id>”.
error.job.invalid_transition.title: Invalid job state transition
error.job.invalid_transition.what: A job in the “{current}” state cannot move to the “{target}” state.
error.job.not_resumable.hint: Start the calculation again — the draft geometry is preserved.
error.job.not_resumable.title: This calculation cannot be resumed
error.job.not_resumable.what: Job {job} has no checkpoint to resume from.
error.molecule.empty.hint: Add at least one atom to the structure — a calculation without atoms has no physical meaning.
error.molecule.empty.title: The molecule is empty
error.molecule.empty.what: The structure contains no atoms, so no calculation can be built.
error.molecule.invalid_multiplicity.hint: Allowed values: {allowed}. For an even number of electrons this is usually a singlet (1) or a triplet (3).
error.molecule.invalid_multiplicity.what: With charge {charge} the system holds {electrons} electrons, so multiplicity {multiplicity} is impossible.
error.molecule.unknown_element.hint: Check the element symbol: periodic-table symbols are supported, without typos or stray spaces.
error.molecule.unknown_element.title: Unknown chemical element
error.molecule.unknown_element.what: The element symbol {symbol} was not recognized.
error.molecule.valence_violation.hint: Check the bond orders and geometry: atoms that are too close give a valence above the allowed value.
error.molecule.valence_violation.title: Atom valence violated
error.molecule.valence_violation.what: Atom {symbol} (index {index}) has {actual} bonds, while its typical valence is {expected}.
error.optimization.not_converged.hint: Starting from a force-field pre-optimization or tightening the SCF criterion usually helps.
error.optimization.not_converged.title: Geometry optimization did not converge
error.optimization.not_converged.what: After {steps} steps the maximum gradient {max_gradient} is still above the threshold {threshold}.
error.registry.basis_not_found.hint: Check the spelling, or add a custom basis through the basis registry.
error.registry.basis_not_found.title: Basis set not found
error.registry.basis_not_found.what: The {basis} basis set is missing from the basis-set registry.
error.registry.functional_not_found.hint: Check the functional name with “quantumlab capabilities --kind functional”: only verified functionals are available.
error.registry.functional_not_found.what: The {functional} exchange-correlation functional is missing from the functional registry.
error.runtime.out_of_memory.hint: Raise the memory limit, enable direct SCF, or reduce the basis set.
error.runtime.out_of_memory.title: Out of memory
error.runtime.out_of_memory.what: The calculation process was killed for lack of memory (requested {requested}, available {available}).
error.scf.not_converged.hint: This is typical for systems with near-degenerate orbitals: radicals, transition metals, excited states.
error.scf.not_converged.title: The electronic structure did not reach the required convergence
error.scf.not_converged.what: The solver tried to find a stable electronic state, but the iterative procedure did not converge in {iterations} iterations (residual {residual}).
error.storage.artifact_missing.hint: The result file is missing from storage. Make sure the data directory was not cleaned up, and rerun the calculation if needed.
error.storage.artifact_missing.title: Result file is unavailable
error.storage.artifact_missing.what: Artifact {artifact} was not found in the scientific data store.

tooltip.basis.if_changed: A bigger basis raises accuracy and cost; energies from different bases are not directly comparable.
tooltip.basis.relevant_for: All calculations; diffuse functions are mandatory for anions and non-covalent interactions.
tooltip.basis.title: Basis set
tooltip.basis.what: The set of mathematical functions used to expand the molecular orbitals.
tooltip.basis.why: A larger basis describes the electron density better but costs noticeably more resources.
tooltip.charge.if_changed: Changing the charge changes the electron count and the allowed multiplicities.
tooltip.charge.title: Molecular charge
tooltip.charge.what: Total electric charge of the system in units of the elementary charge.
tooltip.charge.why: It defines how many electrons the calculation has and affects every computed property.
tooltip.device.if_changed: If no GPU implementation exists, the job automatically stays on the CPU.
tooltip.device.relevant_for: Large molecules, DFT with big grids, MP2.
tooltip.device.title: Compute device
tooltip.device.what: Where the heavy part of the calculation runs: CPU or GPU.
tooltip.device.why: GPUs accelerate tensor and integral kernels, but not every algorithm is implemented for them.
tooltip.dispersion.if_changed: Without the correction, non-covalent complex energies are far too high.
tooltip.dispersion.relevant_for: Non-covalent complexes, catalysis, organic crystals, large molecules.
tooltip.dispersion.title: Dispersion correction
tooltip.dispersion.what: An empirical term accounting for long-range van der Waals attraction.
tooltip.dispersion.why: Standard functionals without it underestimate binding in complexes and condensed phases.
tooltip.functional.if_changed: Another functional brings another systematic error; comparing energies across functionals is not physically meaningful.
tooltip.functional.relevant_for: All DFT calculations; especially critical for reaction barriers and weak interactions.
tooltip.functional.title: Exchange-correlation functional
tooltip.functional.what: The approximation used in DFT for electron exchange and correlation.
tooltip.functional.why: The choice directly controls the accuracy of energies, geometries and reaction barriers.
tooltip.grid.if_changed: Too coarse a grid degrades geometries and frequencies; too fine a grid slows the run.
tooltip.grid.relevant_for: Frequency calculations, weakly interacting systems, meta-GGA functionals.
tooltip.grid.title: Quadrature grid
tooltip.grid.what: The set of spatial points where the electron density is integrated numerically in DFT.
tooltip.grid.why: Grid density controls the numerical accuracy of integration and the noise in gradients.
tooltip.integral_threshold.if_changed: Overly aggressive screening introduces an uncontrolled energy error.
tooltip.integral_threshold.relevant_for: Large molecules, batch runs, screening campaigns.
tooltip.integral_threshold.title: Integral screening threshold
tooltip.integral_threshold.what: The magnitude below which two-electron integrals are not evaluated.
tooltip.integral_threshold.why: Screening is the main speed-up source for medium and large molecules.
tooltip.memory.if_changed: A larger budget allows caching integrals instead of recomputing them.
tooltip.memory.title: Memory budget
tooltip.memory.what: Maximum amount of RAM available to the calculation.
tooltip.memory.why: Running out of memory kills the job and loses progress.
tooltip.multiplicity.if_changed: A wrong value targets a different electronic state, so the energy and geometry describe another system.
tooltip.multiplicity.relevant_for: Radicals, triplet states, transition-metal complexes, dissociating bonds.
tooltip.multiplicity.title: Multiplicity
tooltip.multiplicity.what: A number tied to the total electron spin: 2S+1. For closed shells you normally pick “Singlet” (1).
tooltip.multiplicity.why: It sets how electrons are distributed over spins and whether the shell is open or closed.
tooltip.scf_threshold.if_changed: Tightening the threshold costs more SCF iterations but makes geometries and frequencies reliable.
tooltip.scf_threshold.relevant_for: Optimizations, frequencies, calculations of small energy differences.
tooltip.scf_threshold.title: SCF convergence threshold
tooltip.scf_threshold.what: How small the residual must become for the electronic structure to count as converged.
tooltip.scf_threshold.why: A loose threshold produces noisy gradients and breaks geometry optimization.
tooltip.threads.if_changed: Beyond the saturation point extra threads add almost no speed.
tooltip.threads.relevant_for: All calculations; especially integral and SCF stages.
tooltip.threads.title: Thread count
tooltip.threads.what: How many CPU cores take part in the calculation simultaneously.
tooltip.threads.why: Parallelism shortens wall time until memory bandwidth saturates.
warning.basis_spherical_scheme: Basis {basis} is published in a spherical scheme; the calculation used Cartesian Gaussians. The energy differs from tabulated values by roughly 1e-4 Eh.
warning.dipole_origin_charged: The system is charged (q = {charge}): the dipole moment depends on the origin and is reported relative to the coordinate origin.
warning.frequencies_imaginary: Imaginary frequencies found: {values} cm^-1. This is a saddle point on the energy surface, not a minimum.
warning.frequencies_off_stationary: Frequencies were computed away from a stationary point: the maximum force {max_force} Eh/bohr exceeds the threshold {threshold}. The values do not carry their usual physical meaning — run a geometry optimization first.
warning.grid_prune_unimplemented: Angular grid pruning (grid.prune) is not implemented: the angular grid is complete at every atom. The calculation is correct but uses more points than needed.
warning.grid_xc_integration: XC integration: {points} grid points (preset {preset}); the result depends on the preset — comparisons with other programs are meaningful only on a comparable grid
warning.optimization_not_converged: Geometry optimization did not converge in {steps} steps: max|F| = {max_force} Eh/bohr. The reported geometry is the last point reached, not an equilibrium structure.
warning.scf_not_converged: SCF did not converge in {iterations} iterations; the energy is reported as is
